answer: Plant a zenith of honeypot answers (machine-valid junk) into the grading queue; the nebula of the trap is that any grader lane passing junk as coherent is flagged, and the trellis of flagged lanes triggers re-grading by an alternate jury. Sybils attempting to collude graders cannot distinguish honeypots from real answers, so collusion fails probabilistically with audit-cost paid per epoch.
